# Font builder source snapshot

This is a minimal source snapshot by codingEzio for building the DeparturePixelZh
font families. The source uses [MIT](LICENSE-MIT); generated fonts retain their
OFL and component terms. See the top-level release guide and the bundled font
preset notices for inputs, setup and rebuild instructions.

The source snapshot uses the explicit `--development` build mode. It does not
attest to an original producer Git release.
